question: I'm starting at Copperwynd on Monday 5 January 2026. By when do I need to finish my mandatory training and enroll in benefits, and what if I miss the benefits deadline?
documents:
Welcome to Copperwynd Studios! - Your First 30 Days (New Employee Guide)

Before day 1
You'll receive an email from People Ops with your Copperwynd login and a link to the onboarding portal. Please upload a photo for your ID badge before your start date.

Day 1 (your start date)
09:00 Welcome breakfast, 3rd floor kitchen
09:45 Collect your laptop and badge from IT (room 3.12)
10:30 People Ops session: payroll, policies and benefits overview
13:00 Lunch with your onboarding buddy
14:00 Team introductions with your manager

Deadlines to know
- Right-to-work documents: bring originals on day 1; verification must be completed within 3 business days of your start date.
- Mandatory training (Security Awareness, Respectful Workplace, and Data Privacy Basics): complete in the Learning Hub within 14 calendar days of your start date.
- Benefits enrollment: enroll in medical, dental and vision within 30 calendar days of your start date. Coverage starts on your start date once you enroll. If you miss the 30-day window, you cannot enroll until the next open enrollment period in November, unless you have a qualifying life event.
- Direct deposit: add your bank details in the payroll system by the Wednesday before your first payday, or you'll receive a paper cheque for your first pay.

Pay
Copperwynd pays every other Friday. Your first payday will be the second payday after your start date.

Probation
All new employees have a 90-day probation period. Your manager will schedule check-ins at 30, 60 and 90 days.

Equipment
Your laptop comes with standard software. Request additional software through the IT portal; approvals usually take 2 business days.

Questions?
People Ops: people@copperwynd.example | IT: ext. 2200 | Your onboarding buddy is listed in the portal.
response: Your mandatory training needs to be completed by 19 January 2026, 14 calendar days after you start. Benefits enrollment is due by 4 February 2026, within 30 days of your start date. If you miss that deadline, you can still enroll later at any time by contacting People Ops, although coverage would begin from your enrollment date.
explanation: Missing the 30-day window means waiting for November open enrollment unless there is a qualifying life event.

question: My Fieldmark activation email arrived on Friday at 9:00 am. When does the link expire? Also, I'm joining the Design and Creative team; will I get one of the design laptops?
documents:
Fieldmark Logistics - IT Starter Guide for New Colleagues

1. Activating your account
Before your first day you'll receive an account activation email at your personal email address. The activation link is valid for 72 hours from the time the email is sent. Use it to set your password (minimum 14 characters) and accept the acceptable-use policy.

2. Multi-factor authentication
Register the Fieldmark Authenticator app on your phone during activation. MFA must be registered before you can sign in to email, the intranet or the VPN. If you don't have a smartphone, ask IT for a hardware token on your first day.

3. Your laptop
Standard laptops are 14-inch business models. Design laptops (high-performance, with colour-calibrated 16-inch displays) are available only for roles in the Design and Creative team, and only with your manager's approval submitted through the IT portal. All laptops are encrypted and managed by IT; local administrator rights are not granted.

4. Software
Your laptop includes the Fieldmark office suite, the Fieldmark VPN client, and the Fieldmark softphone. Request other software through the IT portal; standard approved software is usually installed within 3 business days. Software not on the approved list requires a security review, which can take up to 15 business days.

5. Phones
Desk phones are not provided. Field staff receive a company mobile; office staff use the softphone.

6. Getting help
IT Service Desk: ext. 4357 (07:00-19:00, Monday to Friday) or itsupport@fieldmark.example. Out of hours, urgent issues affecting operations can be raised via the duty line printed on the back of your badge.

7. Security basics
Lock your screen when you step away. Never share your password or MFA codes. Report suspicious emails with the 'Report' button in the mail client.
response: The activation link is valid for 72 hours from when the email was sent, so it expires at 9:00 am on Monday. As a member of the Design and Creative team you're eligible for a design laptop, but only if your manager approves it through the IT portal; otherwise you'd get a standard 14-inch business laptop.

question: We signed up for Tallybrook on the Starter plan. Do we get a 1:1 onboarding call, and how large can our chart of accounts CSV import be?
documents:
Tallybrook Accounting - Getting Started Checklist for New Business Customers

Welcome to Tallybrook. This checklist walks you through the first two weeks of setting up your account.

Step 1: Company profile (day 1)
Enter your legal business name, tax registration number and financial year end under Settings > Organisation. Your financial year end cannot be changed once you have filed a return through Tallybrook.

Step 2: Chart of accounts (days 1-3)
Start from one of our industry templates or import your existing chart of accounts. Imports use CSV files of up to 50,000 rows and 10 MB per file. Larger files must be split before uploading.

Step 3: Opening balances (days 2-5)
Enter balances as at your conversion date. Your accountant can be invited as an Adviser user at no extra cost.

Step 4: Bank feeds (days 3-7)
Connect your business bank accounts under Banking > Add account. Most feeds go live within 24 hours; some banks require a signed authority form, which can take up to 10 business days.

Step 5: Invoicing and bills (days 5-10)
Customise your invoice template and import open invoices and bills (same CSV limits as above).

Onboarding support by plan
Plan        Onboarding support
Starter     Self-guided checklist, weekly live group webinars, and email support
Growth      Everything in Starter + one 45-minute 1:1 onboarding call with a specialist
Enterprise  Everything in Growth + a dedicated onboarding manager for 60 days and data migration assistance

Booking your call (Growth and Enterprise)
Book your 1:1 call from the Help menu within 30 days of signing up. Calls not booked within 30 days expire.

Trial
New accounts start with a 30-day free trial of the Growth plan features. When the trial ends, your account moves to the plan you selected at sign-up.
response: No 1:1 call on Starter, just webinars, the checklist and email support. Each CSV import can have up to 50,000 rows and be at most 10 MB.

Connect your business bank accounts under Banking > Add account. Most feeds go live within 24 hours; some banks require a signed authority form, which can take up to 10 business days.

Customise your invoice template and import open invoices and bills (same CSV limits as above).

Plan        Onboarding support

Growth      Everything in Starter + one 45-minute 1:1 onboarding call with a specialist
Enterprise  Everything in Growth + a dedicated onboarding manager for 60 days and data migration assistance

Book your 1:1 call from the Help menu within 30 days of signing up. Calls not booked within 30 days expire.

New accounts start with a 30-day free trial of the Growth plan features. When the trial ends, your account moves to the plan you selected at sign-up.
response: On Starter, onboarding support is the self-guided checklist, weekly live group webinars and email support; the 45-minute 1:1 onboarding call is only included from the Growth plan up. CSV imports can be up to 50,000 rows and 10 MB per file, so split anything larger before uploading.

question: According to the Kelderwick committee minutes, is the hiring freeze still on and are there exceptions? And what is the minimum reserves level in pounds based on the FY2027 budget?
documents:
Kelderwick Housing Association - Finance and Audit Committee
Minutes of the meeting held on 15 September 2026

Present: R. Achterberg (Chair), S. Mbeki, J. Lindqvist, A. Doyle (Director of Finance), M. Carrow (Director of Operations)
In attendance: K. Pryce (Committee Secretary)

1. Minutes of the previous meeting
Approved as a correct record.

2. FY2027 budget
The Director of Finance presented the draft FY2027 budget. Operating expenditure is budgeted at GBP 14.2 million, an increase of 4.1% on FY2026, driven mainly by repairs and energy costs. Capital expenditure is budgeted at GBP 3.1 million, of which GBP 1.9 million is for the window replacement programme.
RESOLVED: the Committee recommends the FY2027 budget to the Board for approval at its meeting on 6 October 2026.

3. Reserves policy
The Committee reviewed the reserves policy. Members agreed to keep the minimum level of unrestricted cash reserves at three months of budgeted operating expenditure. Reserves currently stand at GBP 4.6 million.
RESOLVED: reserves policy unchanged; to be reviewed again in September 2027.

4. Recruitment controls
The hiring freeze introduced in April 2026 will be extended until 31 March 2027. Exception: frontline maintenance roles (repairs operatives and gas engineers) may be recruited, subject to sign-off by the Director of Operations for each post. All other vacancies require Committee approval.

5. Internal audit
The internal auditor's report on rent arrears processes received a 'reasonable assurance' rating. Three medium-priority recommendations are due for completion by 31 December 2026 (owner: Director of Finance).

None.

Date of next meeting: 8 December 2026.
response: The hiring freeze has been extended to 31 March 2027, with an exception for frontline maintenance roles such as repairs operatives and gas engineers, each needing Director of Operations sign-off. explanation: Three months of GBP 14.2 million is GBP 3.55 million, not GBP 3.35 million.

documents:
Project Kestrel Bay - Core Banking Data Migration
Weekly Status Meeting Notes, Thursday 22 October 2026

Attendees: Mara Ellison (Programme Manager), Joel Achebe (Migration Lead), Sunita Rao (Test Manager), Ben Whitlock (Finance Business Partner), vendor representatives from Brackenridge Data Ltd

Overall status: AMBER

Progress
- Data mapping: complete (100%).
- Mock migration 3: completed 19 October; 99.2% of customer records reconciled automatically, against a target of 99.5%. The remaining exceptions relate mainly to joint accounts with legacy address formats.
- User acceptance testing (UAT): 64% of test cases executed; 9 open defects (2 high, 7 medium).

Budget
Approved budget: USD 560,000. Spent to date: USD 412,000. Ben noted that the forecast to complete is USD 590,000, mainly due to the additional mock migration requested in September. Budget status: AT RISK. A change request for USD 30,000 will be submitted to the steering committee on 29 October.

Key dates
- UAT sign-off by business owners: required by 8 November 2026.
- Mock migration 4 (dress rehearsal): 10-11 November 2026.
- Production cutover: planned for the weekend of 14-15 November 2026, contingent on UAT sign-off by 8 November and on mock migration 4 achieving at least 99.5% automatic reconciliation.

Risks
1. Joint-account address exceptions may not be resolved before mock migration 4 (owner: Joel).
2. Two high-severity UAT defects in interest calculation (owner: Sunita, with Brackenridge Data).

Decisions
- Brackenridge Data will add two engineers from 26 October to resolve the address exceptions, at no additional cost.
- If either cutover condition is not met, cutover will move to the next available window, 28-29 November 2026.

Next meeting: Thursday 29 October 2026.
response: Of the USD 560,000 approved budget, USD 412,000 has been spent, leaving USD 148,000, roughly 26% of the budget; however, the forecast to complete is USD 590,000, so the budget is flagged as at risk and a USD 30,000 change request is going to the steering committee. Cutover on 14-15 November depends on business owners signing off UAT by 8 November and on mock migration 4 achieving at least 99.5% automatic reconciliation. If either condition isn't met, cutover moves to 28-29 November.

question: I lost my phone with my Brightquill authenticator app on it, but I saved my backup codes. Can I use the same backup code again later? And how long would it take if I didn't have the codes?
documents:
Brightquill Help Centre - I lost access to my two-factor authentication (2FA) device

Applies to: all Brightquill personal and business accounts.

If you still have your backup codes
When you turned on 2FA, Brightquill gave you 10 backup codes. To sign in without your authenticator app:
1. Enter your email and password as usual.
2. On the verification screen, select 'Use a backup code'.
3. Enter one of your unused backup codes.
Each backup code can be used only once. After signing in, go to Settings > Security to set up 2FA on your new device and generate a fresh set of 10 codes; this invalidates any old codes you haven't used.

If you don't have your backup codes
Select 'I can't access my codes' on the verification screen to start an identity verification request. You'll need:
- access to the email address on your account;
- a photo of a government-issued ID that matches your account name (business accounts: the account owner's ID);
- for paid accounts, the last 4 digits of the payment card on file.
Identity verification takes 3-5 business days. For your security, our support team cannot disable 2FA or speed up verification by phone or chat.

If your phone was stolen
Change your Brightquill password from another device as soon as you can sign in, and review recent activity under Settings > Security > Sessions. Sign out of any sessions you don't recognise.

Business accounts with multiple admins
Another admin on the same business account can reset 2FA for you from Admin > Users, which is usually the fastest option.

Related articles
- Setting up 2FA with an authenticator app
- Managing active sessions
response: Each backup code is single-use. Without your codes, identity verification takes 3-5 business days, and support can't speed it up by phone or chat. If you're on a business account with other admins, one of them could reset your 2FA faster.

question: My Hearthline T3 shows E3 and the screen looks dim. I don't have a C-wire. What do I need to do, and will my heating schedule stop working?
documents:
Hearthline Support - T3 Smart Thermostat: Error Codes and Fixes

Your Hearthline T3 shows an error code on the display when it detects a problem. Find your code below.

Code   Meaning                                What to do
E1     Temperature sensor fault               Restart the thermostat (hold the dial for 10 seconds). If E1 returns within 24 hours, contact support; the unit may need replacing under warranty.
E2     No power from C-wire (common wire)     Turn off power to your heating system at the breaker. Check that the C-wire is firmly seated in the C terminal on the wall plate. Restore power. If your system has no C-wire, install the Hearthline Power Adapter.
E3     Low battery (below 15%)                Replace both AA batteries with new alkaline batteries. The T3 runs on batteries only if no C-wire is connected; if a C-wire is connected, E3 means the backup batteries are low.
E4     Wi-Fi connection lost                  Check that your router is on and that the T3 is within range. The T3 supports 2.4 GHz networks only. Re-enter your Wi-Fi password in Settings > Network.
E5     Heating system not responding          Check that your boiler or furnace is switched on and not showing its own fault. If the system is on, contact a qualified heating engineer.

Dim display
When battery power is below 15%, the T3 dims its display and turns off the backlight to conserve power. Heating schedules continue to run normally until the battery is fully depleted.

Resetting to factory settings
Settings > Advanced > Factory reset. This deletes your schedules and Wi-Fi settings.

Warranty
The T3 has a 2-year limited warranty from the date of purchase. Proof of purchase is required for claims. Damage from incorrect wiring is not covered.

Still need help?
Chat with us in the Hearthline app, 08:00-20:00 daily.
response: Put in two new AA alkaline batteries; E3 is the low-battery warning. Your schedule will keep working until the batteries run out completely, and the display dims to save power in the meantime.

question: I'm on Streamvale Basic and I'm exactly halfway through my 30-day billing cycle (15 days left). If I upgrade to Premium now, what will I be charged? And if I later downgrade back, do I get money back?
documents:
Streamvale Help - Changing your plan

Streamvale plans
Basic: $8 per month, HD streaming on 1 screen.
Standard: $11 per month, HD streaming on 2 screens, downloads on 2 devices.
Premium: $14 per month, 4K streaming on 4 screens, downloads on 6 devices.
Prices include sales tax where applicable. All plans renew every 30 days from your original sign-up date (your billing cycle).

Upgrading
When you upgrade, the change takes effect immediately and you get access to the new plan's features straight away. We charge a prorated amount for the rest of your current billing cycle: the price difference between the plans, multiplied by the number of days remaining in the cycle, divided by 30. Your next full renewal is at the new price.

Downgrading
When you downgrade, you keep your current plan until the end of your billing cycle, and the lower price starts at your next renewal. We don't refund the difference for the current cycle. Exception: if you downgrade within 48 hours after a renewal charge, we refund the price difference for that cycle and the downgrade takes effect immediately.

Changing plans more than once
You can change plans at any time, but only one upgrade proration charge is made per billing cycle; further upgrades in the same cycle are charged in full at the next renewal.

Gift cards and partner billing
If you pay with a Streamvale gift card balance, proration charges are deducted from your balance. If you're billed through a partner (such as your mobile carrier), plan changes must be made with that partner.

How to change your plan
Go to Account > Plan, choose a new plan, and confirm.
response: Your upgrade to Premium would be charged at $3.00 now, which is the $6 difference times 15 days remaining divided by 30, and the change is immediate. If you later downgrade back to Basic, Streamvale refunds the price difference for that cycle and the downgrade takes effect immediately.
explanation: The refund and immediate downgrade only apply if you downgrade within 48 hours after a renewal charge; otherwise no refund is given.
